The SteelSeries Black Friday Sale has kicked off in earnest. You can head over to the SteelSeries online store to catch the complete list of deals, but interestingly Amazon is offering lower prices on several of the items. This is a product-wide discount that slashes up to 40% off Steelseries' best gaming headsets, mice, keyboards, and controllers, dropping them to the lowest prices we've seen all year (and in some cases, ever). This is the official sale and, barring limited time store-exclusuve discounts, these will be the lowest prices we'll see through Black Friday.

SteelSeries Nova Pro Wireless Gaming Headset

Amazon is knocking 26% off a brand new Steelseries Arctis Nova Pro wireless gaming headset for PS5, Xbox, or PC, now just $229.99 with free shipping. The Nova Pro has long been one of IGN's highest rated wireless gaming headsets. IGN's Kevin Lee gave the Nova Pro a 10/10 "Masterpiece" review and I believe it still holds today. I've clocked well over a thousand hours on mine to the point that my earcups were worn through (I replaced them with the awesome WC Freeze gel earpads ). SteelSeries released a successor - the Nova Pro Omni - earlier this year, but it currently sells for $380 and the improvements are certainly not worth the nearly $200 price premium.

The one feature that undoubtedly makes the Nova Pro stand out amongst the crowd is the ingenious hot-swappable battery system. The Nova Pro includes two removable, rechargeable batteries: one to use in your headset and the other to remain charged and ready to go in a base station that doubles as a charger. This way, you get wireless freedom with zero downtime. Each battery lasts for up to 22 hours of continued use so you don't need to swap out too often.

SteelSeries Aeon Pro Gaming Controller

SteelSeries recently released its new Aeon Pro wireless gaming controller for PC and Xbox and it's already on sale at Amazon for $209.99 after a 20% off instant discount. The Aeon Pro employs a hot-swappable battery design for uninterrupted playtime like what you'll find in the SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro headset. The package includes two removable, rechargeable batteries: one to use in your controller and the other to remain charged and ready to go in the docking station that doubles as a charger.

Other premium features include a patented QuickSwitch system that allows you to switch between Xbox, PC, or mobile instantly and seamlessly, with no re-pairing or re-plugging required, Hall Effect joysticks and mechanical micro switches for nearly all of its buttons including the d-pad, XYAB face buttons, four trigger buttons, and four rear paddle switches, an informative OLED display, and swappable thumbsticks. Yes it's expensive, but if you're a heavy gamer that uses a controller for hundreds of hours, then this is so worth it.

SteelSeries Arctis Nova 7 Gen 2 Gaming Headset

The Nova 7 is Steelseries' best selling headset because it offers great build quality and premium features for a competitive price. It's currently $159.99 after a 20% off discount. The Nova 7 is designed for both durability and comfort; the suspension-style headband is comprised of a tough steel core and the breathable AirWeave memory-foam type ear cushions keep your ears from getting sweaty. The big 40mm drivers support 360-degree spatial sound and plenty of low-end for an immersive gaming experience. Other features include dual simultaneous wireless connectivity (2.4GHz WiFi and Bluetooth), USB Type-C charging, and a retractable boom microphone.

SteelSeries Arctis Gamebuds

Ever consider replacing your gaming headset with a pair of earbuds? Here's a chance to do so at a discount. Amazon is offering $50 off the SteelSeries Arctis Gamebuds, now just $149.99. The Gamebuds connects to your PC or gaming console with the included 2.4GHz USB-C dongle, which boasts reduced latency compared to using standard Bluetooth earbuds. Each earbud contains a 6mm neodymium magnetic driver that can simulate bass and spatial audio effects. No headset is complete without a built-in microphone, and the Gamebuds has a decent one, although not nearly as good as an extendable boom mic. I have a pair of these myself and quite like it. I prefer these over standard headphones on hotter days, because my ears sweat profusely when I use traditional over-ear headsets. Not so with these Gamebuds.

SteelSeries Aerox 3 Ultra-Light Gaming Mouse

Amazon is offering the SteelSeries Aerox 3 Wireless Gen 2 for $74.99 after a 32% off instant discount. The Aerox 3 is an ultralight gaming mouse that weighs in at just 68 grams. It has a perforated shell to reduce the weight, mechanical switch keys rated at 80 million clicks, and an AQUABARRIER hydrophobic coating applied to the interior circuitry for added durability. The Aerox 3 connects wirelessly via either a 2.4GHz dongle or Bluetooth. You'll want to stick with the dongle to take advantage of the lower latency. Pair that with 4K wireless polling and a TRUEMOVE 26,000 DPI sensor with 400 IPS speed and 40G acceleration and the Aerox 3 will certainly not be the limiting factor to your win-loss ratio.
